model_name: BTC entry classifier — 5-bar vertical barrier variant
model_type: CatBoostClassifier (5 independently seeded fits, averaged at inference)

target_definition.direction_convention: raw Signal column (BUY/SELL), NOT execution_signal -- label reflects the technical pattern's true outcome, independent of any ML bucket decision made about it

outcome_labels.vertical: neither barrier hit within 5 bars -> label = 1 if forward return at bar 5 is positive (direction-adjusted), else 0

validation.note: used for early stopping (use_best_model=True), never used to fit weights

test.note: permanent frozen holdout, never touched during training or model selection

data_splits.split_method: chronological, no shuffling, boundaries fixed from the original historical split

sample_weighting.normalization: weights divided by their own mean, so mean weight = 1.0

class_balancing: class_weights={0: 1.0, 1: scale_pos}, where scale_pos = n_class0 / n_class1, recomputed from the training labels at fit time

catboost_hyperparameters.random_seed: one of [42, 43, 44, 45, 46], fit independently per seed

inference: predict_proba averaged across the 5 seed models for the final probability

results.fresh_forward_note: evaluated on 79 live trades (2026-05-10 -> 2026-07-20), never used in training. This is markedly worse than the historical Test AUC -- see METHODOLOGY.md and the accompanying analysis notes for the full investigation into why (staleness, labeling, and feature-window mismatches were all tested and ruled out as the explanation).

reproduction_verified_note: Running train_catboost_model.py against the provided training_data/ CSVs reproduces the reported AUC (0.9128 +/- 0.0015) exactly, confirmed in a clean directory before packaging.
